questions.stem: Find the derivative of y = arctan(x):
questions.solution: The derivative of arctan(x) is dy/dx = 1 / (x^2 + 1). This comes from the differentiation rule for inverse trigonometric functions.
questions.explanation: The derivative of arctan(x) can be found using the chain rule and the fact that the derivative of tan^(-1)(u) with respect to u is 1/(u^2 + 1). In this case, u = x.
